thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: increased 503 rate from egress-proxy cluster eu-west-1 — 6m sustained, impact: ~8% of requests. paging oncall: @jamie :rotating_light:
jamie: I'm on it. pulling logs now. which customers are hit?
arin: looks like most traffic for embeddings and some generation routes hitting the egress-proxy. I see spikes in proxy upstream 502/503 to external model mirrors.
sophia: tagging infra — could be short-lived autoscaling glitch or a rate-limited upstream. nate, any deploys in the last 10m?
nate: no deploys. I see a flurry of retries in the gateway logs: lots of `upstream connect error` and `503 body is empty`. sending snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T09:12:03Z] egress-proxy-1 - upstream://mirror-a/ POST 503 0ms - attempts=1
[2026-03-14T09:12:04Z] egress-proxy-2 - upstream://mirror-b/ POST 502 15ms - attempts=1
```
jamie: could be mirror-side throttling. are our timeout/retry policies making traffic spike?
arin: good call. looks like clients (our gateway) are retrying aggressively on 5xx which causes amplification. current policy: 2 retries immediate. that can double traffic to mirrors during transient failures.
sophia: mitigation idea: enable short-circuit fallback to cached-model-variant for embeddings and reduce retries at the gateway for mirror calls. we can also add a temporary header to mark incident and route low-priority requests to dedicated cached path.
jamie: propose immediate live mitigation: 1) roll out gateway retry throttle to 0 (disable retries) for mirror egress calls 2) enable cached-variant for embeddings 3) increase circuit-breaker sensitivity for egress-proxy cluster to reduce load. can we patch gate fast?
nate: I can push a config change to gateway for the retry header in 5m. prepping patch: `gateway-config: egress.retry.count=0 for mirror-hosts`
arin: I'll flip the circuit-breaker thresholds on egress-proxy now (lower error percentage to trip faster).
runbook-bot: ACTION: creating incident ticket INC-2026-1795001234; summary: egress-proxy -> upstream mirror 5xx amplification.
jamie: making customer impact assessment: affected ~8% of 1 region, no major SSO customers flagged yet. Health page shows degraded for embeddings.
20m later...
ops-bot: DEPLOY OK: gateway-config updated by nate. egress.retry.count=0 applied to mirror-hosts.
nate: verified change propagated to all gateway pods. I also added header `X-RW-Incident: egress-503` so downstream can deprioritize.
arin: circuit-breaker tweak applied. error rate on egress-proxy dropped from 9% -> 2.1% in 5m. request success for embeddings improving.
sophia: rolling back cached-variant routing? we kept it on for safety, traffic is better but slightly higher latency.
jamie: good. customers with latency-sensitive routes: list pushed to #customer-success. No PagerDuty pages.
jamie: immediate follow-ups (short):
- hotfix rolled: gateway retries disabled for mirror hosts (owner: nate)
- circuit breaker tuned (owner: arin)
- cached-variant enabled for embeddings (owner: sophia)
- incident ticket created (INC-2026-1795001234)
- customer comms prepare draft (owner: jamie)

longer-term action items (to be tracked in ticket):
- revise retry/backoff policy for mirror egress to exponential backoff with jitter (owner: eng-platform)
- add rate-limit headers and backpressure signals to model-mirrors (owner: partnerships)
- update runbook: include egress mirror amplification section and default mitigation steps (owner: runbook)
- tune alerts: add 'retry amplification' alert when 5xx + retry increase observed (owner: sre)

jamie: quick postmortem notes: root cause likely transient mirror-side throttling combined with aggressive immediate retries from gateway -> amplification loop. mitigation successful via lowering retry, CB tuning, and cached fallback.
arin: i'll update runbook now and add the alert rule. assigning runbook-bot to open PR.
runbook-bot: CREATED: runbook PR #432: `egress-mirror-5xx-amplification.md` (link: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pulls/432)
jamie: thanks everyone. leaving summary for handoff to oncall for shift change. final status: mitigated, partial degraded for ~28 minutes, current errors under 2%. closing thread after follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
